_meta.description: New troubleshooting entries added in 2026 for groupBy, sortBy, and catalogCollection helpers. Supplement to schema/troubleshooting.json.

groupby_returns_nothing.issue: groupBy helper renders nothing / returns empty string silently
groupby_returns_nothing.primary_cause: HandlebarsArrayHelpers feature flag is disabled for this project
symptoms: Template block renders as empty string
No error is thrown, no output at all
Works in one Iterable project but not another
Block content disappears when groupBy is added
groupby_returns_nothing.solution: Enable the HandlebarsArrayHelpers feature flag for the project. This must be done by an Iterable admin in the platform settings. sortBy has the same requirement and the same silent failure mode.

secondary_causes.symptom: Some groups appear but items are truncated with no warning
secondary_causes.solution: Reduce the array to 100 items or fewer before passing to groupBy. Use a catalog collection (max 50 items) or filter the data upstream.

secondary_causes.cause: Context passed is not an array
secondary_causes.symptom: Handlebars wraps a GroupByInvalidInputException as a HandlebarsException
secondary_causes.solution: Ensure the first argument to groupBy is a valid array. Check that the path resolves to an array in your event data or catalog.

secondary_causes.symptom: Template throws a GroupByMissingFieldException wrapped in HandlebarsException
secondary_causes.solution: Add field="fieldName" to the helper call. field is required.

secondary_causes.cause: Typo in collection name passed to catalogCollection
secondary_causes.symptom: catalogCollection returns empty, groupBy receives empty array, block renders nothing
secondary_causes.solution: Verify the collection name exactly matches the Iterable UI. Names are case-sensitive.

groupby_wrong_key_path.issue: groupBy key values are blank or groups don't match expected values
groupby_wrong_key_path.primary_cause: Using only the leaf field name in the template instead of the full dot path from the field= parameter
groupby_wrong_key_path.explanation: groupBy stores group keys using the FULL field path as nested maps. If field="LineItems.ItemShippingMethod", the key is stored at group.key.LineItems.ItemShippingMethod — NOT at group.key.ItemShippingMethod.
symptoms: {{group.key.fieldName}} renders blank even though data is present
Group keys appear correct in raw data but output is empty in template

simple_field.note: For a top-level field, the key path matches the field name exactly.

debugging_steps: 2. Mirror the exact path in your {{group.key.<path>}} expression
4. For field="x,y", access as {{group.key.x}} and {{group.key.y}} separately

sortby_returns_nothing.issue: sortBy helper renders nothing or returns empty string
sortby_returns_nothing.primary_cause: HandlebarsArrayHelpers feature flag is disabled (same flag as groupBy)
sortby_returns_nothing.solution: Enable HandlebarsArrayHelpers feature flag for the project. sortBy and groupBy share the same flag.
sortby_returns_nothing.note: sortBy was merged June 5, 2026 (PR #30792). If your environment was deployed before that date, the helper may not be available regardless of the feature flag state. Verify the platform version.

at_index_wrong_in_nested_each.issue: @index or @last inside {{#each group.items}} shows wrong values
at_index_wrong_in_nested_each.root_cause: In Java Handlebars (jknack), @index, @first, and @last inside a nested {{#each}} block reflect the outer loop's iteration, not the inner one, when accessed without named block params.
symptoms: @index is always the same value across all items in a group
@first only shows correctly on the first group, not first item of each group
at_index_wrong_in_nested_each.explanation: Named block params (|item iIdx|) give you correctly scoped iteration metadata. iIdx is the zero-based index within the inner each loop.

groupby_missing_items_after_100.issue: groupBy truncates items silently — not all items appear in output
groupby_missing_items_after_100.cause: groupBy has a 100-item hard limit. Arrays larger than 100 items are silently truncated at 100.
symptoms: Some groups are missing that should appear
Item count in groups adds up to less than total items in the array
Works fine with small arrays, fails silently with large ones
groupby_missing_items_after_100.solution: Reduce the input array to 100 or fewer items before passing to groupBy. Options: use a catalog collection (max 50 items), filter the data upstream in your event payload, or segment the data across multiple campaign sends.
groupby_missing_items_after_100.note: The 100-item limit is enforced in the merged PR (#30663). Original draft PR had a 500-item limit. The current production limit is 100.

catalog_field_blank_after_groupby.issue: Catalog item fields render blank inside {{#each group.items}}
catalog_field_blank_after_groupby.cause: Attempting to access fields via dataFields wrapper instead of directly at top level
symptoms: Fields are confirmed present in catalog but empty in template
catalog_field_blank_after_groupby.solution: Access catalog fields directly: {{product.brand}}, {{product.category}}. The dataFields wrapper is not present in the Handlebars context — catalog item fields are flattened to the top level of each item object.

catalog_field_types_not_working.issue: Catalog fields behave as strings even though field type was set (e.g. price won't format as number)
catalog_field_types_not_working.cause: Field type mappings were set AFTER catalog items were already loaded
catalog_field_types_not_working.explanation: Iterable catalog field types must be configured BEFORE ingesting items. Setting types retroactively does not re-type already-loaded data.
solution: 1. Delete all items from the catalog (or recreate the catalog)
fields_to_map_explicitly: categories (string — map as the element type, not as array)
All custom fields at their correct types
catalog_field_types_not_working.note: Standard catalog fields (name, url, price, imageUrl, description, categories) are NOT automatically typed. They must be mapped explicitly.

groupby_with_datafeed_vs_catalog.issue: groupBy works on event data but not on data feed or catalog data
groupby_with_datafeed_vs_catalog.cause: Data feeds use [[field]] syntax and are merged at render time in a different context than groupBy expects. groupBy works on Handlebars-context arrays, not raw data feed arrays.
groupby_with_datafeed_vs_catalog.solution: Use catalogCollection or pass event data arrays directly to groupBy. Data feeds are best used for static campaign-level data, not for arrays to be grouped dynamically.
